baseline.routeScope: Utils.useRoutes mounted HTTP router stacks (comment v2). Commented-out routes and independent Socket.IO/ingest/cron processes are excluded.
middlewareOrder: router.routes() then router.allowedMethods() for each mounted router
baseline.resultNotation: Unless explicitly stated, response describes data in HTTP 200 {code:0,data}; 200/-1 is Result.fail. Numeric pairs mean HTTP status/business code. Generic system errors use 500/500 (production message 服务器内部错误). Undefined fields are omitted by JSON serialization.
baseline.input: Body descriptions list controller/guard fields; non-multipart body fields are normally JSON (koa-bodyparser also accepts form-encoded bodies for parsed methods). Query values are strings, with duplicate keys becoming arrays. See actual guards/services for coercion rather than treating this inventory as a strict schema.
baseline.methodHandling: String paths accept a trailing slash. GET also registers HEAD (no body). Router OPTIONS emits Allow; CORS preflight short circuits with 204. Unsupported method on a matching path can emit plain 405 with Allow. Unknown paths are plain 404. Malformed JSON is caught by global error middleware and emits 500/500 even before JWT.

guards.verifyAuth: RS256 Authorization header; legacy strips the first exact Bearer prefix, so bare JWT works. Missing, invalid or expired JWT: 401/401.
guards.verifyStatus: Reads current account status after JWT; truthy status returns 200/-1 with 您已被封禁.
guards.verifyPermission: Uses first route param (table derived by removing Id) and JWT user id; denied or permission lookup failure is 403/403.
guards.mediaMutationMaintenance: MEDIA_MUTATIONS_PAUSED === "true" returns 503/503 before auth/body upload on flagged routes; bodyparser already ran. R2 write pause is a separate storage setting.
guards.chatRateLimit: First anonymous/public AI chat middleware (function name may be inline); process-local per-IP bucket, 12/minute, 429/429.
guards.completionRateLimit: After JWT; process-local per-user bucket (IP fallback), 30/minute, 429/429.

baseline.mediaAndAI: Limits in src/constants/upload.js and src/constants/ai.js. HTTP AI chat streams AI SDK UIMessage SSE and uses optional model allowlist; health and completion are JSON. Ingest has its own worker, model configuration, and schedule. Public asset URLs and R2/local promotion stay service-owned.
